description: React component for displaying a warning banner related to team membership and guest users in the Mattermost application.

methods.name: getCommaSeparatedUsernames
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated string of usernames with '@' prefix.

methods.name: getGuestMessage
methods.description: Returns a formatted message about guest users needing to be invited before being added to the channel.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns a formatted message about users being added to the channel once they are part of the team.
